errors.text: The proposed Mo-alloying intervention does not reconstruct the target temperature-dependent nanoindentation and friction study of an FeNiCrCoCu coating.
No numerical temperature range, load, velocity, counterface, atmosphere, or sliding geometry is specified, so the claim of improvement across operating temperatures is not bounded or reproducible.
The strong-oxide-layer mechanism is misattributed: the cited evidence assigns oxide-layer strengthening to W and V, not specifically to Mo.
Evidence from particular bulk refractory and CoCrFeNiMo alloys is generalized to unspecified HEA coatings without evidence that the effect persists across coating architectures and temperatures.
